verdict.rationale: The Agent Skills spec requires YAML frontmatter in every SKILL.md, and agents load each skill's name and description at startup to decide when it is relevant, so the description doubles as the activation trigger. A hands-on probe confirmed `skills add --list` shows every skill's name and full trigger description without installing, and `skills use` prints the generated prompt for review. Missing for 10: no explicit evidence that name/description are mandatory spec fields or that description quality is enforced (only a `skills-ref validate` mention), and the skills.sh site listing reportedly doesn't surface descriptions inline.
